p5e8c2b43c7.notes: Lower of two Budapest enamel street plates at dusk with flash glare, partly covered by twigs and dry seed pods: the 'r' of Barackfa and the 'X' of 'XI.' are mostly hidden by a branch (read from the visible strokes and the district). House-number range 16 -> 20 with arrow. The upper plate 'XI. kerület, Sasad / Cseresznye utca / 40 <- 50' is heavily obscured and is a distractor.

pf4bcbff296.notes: Laser-cut letters in a green steel panel at a playground entrance, Budapest; graffiti tag above. The gate notice 'GESZTENYÉS JÁTSZÓTÉR' (opening hours, +36 1 688 69 99) and a summer-camp poster are secondary signs/distractors.

pd95547e6aa.notes: White script fascia of a small grocery at night, Budapest. The board beside the window repeats the name with opening hours ('Nyitvatartás / Hétköznap: 07:00 - 19:00 / Szombat: 07:00 - 13:00 / Vasárnap zárva') and a product list; a hair-salon card in the window is a distractor.

p61941c9cd6.notes: Brown-on-cream Budapest street plate with the district crest and a pointing-hand arrow (3 <- 1) on a fence; 'lépcső' = stairway. The red hydrant marker 'T 100 / 1,0 / 1,1' beside it is a distractor.

p99691896f3.notes: Enamel street plate on a low railing, Budapest, at a slight angle; arrow 9 -> 1. Rust has eaten the area after the final '1', so a second digit may be missing.

p378b5dedca.notes: Enamel street plate on a chain-link fence, Budapest, angled view; arrow 1 -> 7. 'udvar' = courtyard (a residential close).

p7f0551d20e.notes: Green lightbox over a beauty-salon door, Budapest, in dappled shade. The smaller service line beneath ('KOZMETIKA - FODRÁSZAT - KÉZ- ÉS LÁBÁPOLÁS', accents uncertain), the door lettering (www.badacsonyiszepsegszalon.hu, service list), no-smoking and 'MAGÁN PARKOLÓ' signs are distractors.
